title: Irish Today
body: Irish history, language, and culture in a repeatable daily page.

title: Your Passage
body: A quieter, personalized daily reading experience from the same engine.

title: Loudsource
body: Vote tracks up the queue and turn a music page into a shared experience.

title: Garage Journey
body: Vehicle-specific workshops, repair references, and a growing guitar workbench.
details: Start with a vehicle or instrument, then explore its workshop, diagrams, manuals, and useful reference sources. The car-to-guitar expansion explores how the same guide structure can serve a different kind of owner.
outcome: Make scattered information easier to use.
technical: A Python/Flask application built from the Daily Flyer Engine. A shared workshop structure organizes vehicle-specific reference material; an instrument implementation adapts that approach for guitars.

The stable garage_journey route selects the workshop shell rather than pinning a version. It links to reference sources; those sources still need to be checked for the particular vehicle, instrument, and task.
plain_body: One place to find guides and reference material for a vehicle or guitar.

title: DSL
body: Turn-based battles with shared matches, co-op play, and fog of war.
details: Double Secret Probation Squad Leader turns the engine toward an interactive hex-map game: move units, manage actions, and coordinate with another player. Maps, AI opponents, and rules are still evolving.

title: Bug Tracker
body: Hell Let Loose Vietnam issues, with official updates separated from player reports.

title: Soph(more) Slump(?)
body: Explore first- and second-year performance in football, baseball, and bowling.
details: Compare players, switch presets, and choose how much statistical detail to show. This is a historical-data explorer, not a live sports feed or a claim that every player follows the same second-year pattern.

title: Galaxy Granite
body: A countertop-business journal prototype: useful articles, project notes, and a clear next step.
details: A business-site prototype with rotating homeowner topics, previous/next reading, and a clear quote-to-installation process. It explores a focused journal rather than reproducing an entire company website.
outcome: Make a business website easier to understand.
technical: A Daily Flyer Engine theme served through Flask: structured article content, seeded topic rotation, previous/next navigation, and a quote-to-installation explanation.
Focused route tests cover rendering, theme aliases, and rotation. This is a hosted prototype, not the company’s official website or evidence of measured commercial results.
plain_body: A simpler way to browse countertop ideas, understand the process, and find a next step. Hosted prototype.

title: Jiporady
body: A living-room trivia board built for playing together.

title: Career Compass
body: Structured job-search thinking and clearer career direction.

title: Grepper
body: Compare job-posting search with profile-based parsing and ranking.
outcome: Make a search workflow easier to evaluate.
technical: The browser demo separates title-first job search from profile-based ranking, using a bundled snapshot so visitors can compare the two approaches without a live scraping request.
JavaScript handles the comparison; browser tests check its behavior. The demo illustrates the workflow and is not a live feed of current job openings.
plain_body: A working demo that compares a basic job search with results matched to a person's experience.
